verdict.rationale: Docs mention Claude Code reading 'design docs' from Google Drive and updating a template based on 'Figma designs posted in Slack' via MCP, suggesting some design-to-code capability, but there is no explicit evidence of directly uploading a sketch, screenshot, or PDF wireframe and generating a full working app from it. Missing for 10: direct image/PDF upload workflow, hands-on demo of sketch-to-app generation, independent corroboration of this specific use case.
